# axual_application_access_grants (Data Source)

Lists application access grants, for example the open requests on a topic. Works on every Terraform version; for generating config, see `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14). Shows the grants as they were when the plan started, before the decisions of the same run.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_type` (String) `CONSUMER` or `PRODUCER`.
- `application` (String) Application UID or name.
- `environment` (String) Environment UID.
- `statuses` (List of String) Only grants with these statuses: `Pending`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `Revoked`, `Cancelled`.
- `topic` (String) Topic UID.

### Read-Only

- `grants` (Attributes List) The grants that match, as far as the signed-in user may see them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Read-Only:

- `access_type` (String) `CONSUMER` or `PRODUCER`.
- `application` (String) Application UID.
- `application_name` (String) Application name.
- `decided_at` (String) When the grant was approved, rejected or revoked. Null while the grant is `Pending` or `Cancelled`, also when it was decided before and has been requested again.
- `decided_by` (String) Who approved, rejected or revoked the grant. Null while the grant is `Pending` or `Cancelled`.
- `decision_reason` (String) The reason the topic team gave when it rejected or revoked the grant. Null unless the status is `Rejected` or `Revoked`.
- `environment` (String) Environment UID.
- `id` (String) Grant UID.
- `requested_at` (String) When the application team last requested access.
- `status` (String) Grant status.
- `topic` (String) Topic UID.
